evidence.raw_description: Unenhanced video timestamped 22:15 at 4th Street corner.
evidence.analyzed_data: Facial recognition matches Elena Rostova stationary near delivery gate.

evidence.name: Discarded 9mm Service Pistol
evidence.raw_description: Recovered from storm drain two blocks north of exchange.
evidence.analyzed_data: Ballistics match fatal slug in guard. Latent palm print matches Marcus Vance.

claims.statement: I was waiting at the bus stop on 4th Street looking at my phone the entire time.
claims.admission: Alright! I was standing by the delivery gate, but Marcus swore it was just an after-hours insurance grab! I never went inside!

claims.statement: I was three miles away having beers at O'Malley's Pub paying cash.
claims.admission: The guard lunged at me with a baton in the dark! The gun discharged by accident during the struggle!
